transcript: Speaker A: Sir sleeper coach में कैसे जाना है? [Sir, how do I get to the sleeper coach?] Speaker B: Go straight from here and after three compartments you will reach the sleeper coach. Speaker A: Sir समझा नहीं। अंग्रेजी अच्छे से नहीं आती। [Sir, I didn't understand. I don't know English well.] Speaker B: अरे आज के समय में अंग्रेजी समझना और बोलना दोनों जरूरी हैं। सीख क्यों नहीं लेते? [Oh, nowadays understanding and speaking English are both important. Why don't you learn?] Speaker A: Sir मेरे पास समय कहाँ है? आपने कहाँ से सीखी? [Sir, where do I have time? Where did you learn it from?] Speaker B: मैंने तो SpeakEasy app से सीखी है। और ज्यादा समय की जरूरत भी नहीं है। इस app पर बस 10-15 मिनट अभ्यास करो and your English will get better in some days. [I learned from the SpeakEasy app. And you don't need much time. Just practice 10-15 minutes on this app and your English will get better in some days.] Speaker A: यह SpeakEasy app क्या है? [What is this SpeakEasy app?] Speaker B: इस app में Vani AI teacher है, जिसके साथ तुम बिना किसी judgement के practice कर सकते हो। और best part कि गलतियाँ करोगे तो AI तुरंत correct भी कर देती है। [In this app, there is Vani AI teacher, with whom you can practice without any judgment. And the best part is if you make mistakes, the AI corrects them immediately.] Speaker A: पर Sir यह app तो महंगा होगा ना। [But Sir, this app must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: बिल्कुल नहीं। मैंने तो बस ₹1 में शुरू किया था। तुम भी कर सकते हो। [Not at all. I started for just 1 rupee. You can too.] Speaker A: कैसे start करूँ? [How do I start?] Speaker B: बस install button पर click करो। SpeakEasy app install करो and अपनी English learning journey शुरू करो। [Just click on the install button. Install the SpeakEasy app and start your English learning journey.] Speaker C: अभी SpeakEasy app डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: A boy on a train struggles to understand English directions from a ticket collector, who advises him to use the SpeakEasy app. The collector highlights that the app requires only 10-15 minutes of daily practice, features an AI teacher that corrects mistakes without judgment, and costs just 1 rupee to start. The ad concludes with an AI presenter urging viewers to download the app to speak fluent English.
